findings.rule: releases unsealed only when every failing check's reason was delivered.
findings.input: Guarded fire (stop_hook_active) where the compliance log holds no blocked record for this turnKey (delivered.size === 0, e.g. the first block's record was not written) and two checks fail: `delivered.size > 0 &&` short-circuits, `unheard` is false, and the hook releases unsealed although no failing check's reason was ever delivered.
findings.finding: The release path is still gated on `delivered.size > 0`, so a guarded fire with an empty delivered set releases unsealed without every failing check's reason having been delivered.

findings.rule: The declarations reminder gives the command with `. ~/.claude/session.env &&` before it
findings.input: A turn whose declaration fails the no-update check receives the reminder at declarations.mjs:193, which still says `node ${LEDGER} declare <your declaration> --no-update ...` with no `. ~/.claude/session.env &&`; the model runs it, declare writes the legacy turn-summary.txt, and the hook keeps preferring the v2 file.
findings.finding: Only one of the declarations reminder's two declare commands gained the session.env prefix; the second still teaches the form that writes the wrong file.
